# acloud_organisation (Data Source)

Get an organisation

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Without slug, the organisation of the provider is used.
data "acloud_organisation" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `slug` (String) Slug of the Organisation. Defaults to the `organisation` of the provider.

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) Contact email address of the Organisation.
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the Organisation.
